Recorded Graph API responses for the Meta publishers (CLP-94).

The shapes follow the official Graph API reference (v26.0): `/{page-id}/video_reels`
(start and finish), `rupload.facebook.com` uploads, `/{ig-user-id}/media` (REELS,
resumable), `/{container-id}?fields=status_code`, `/{ig-user-id}/media_publish`,
`/{ig-user-id}/content_publishing_limit`, `/debug_token` and the Graph error object.

IDs are fake. No token, Page or account in these files is real, and no test calls Meta.
